candidate.name: Ledgerline
candidate.description: AI bookkeeping automation for dental practices.

evidence.title: Ledgerline - YC company profile
evidence.excerpt: Ledgerline automates bookkeeping for dental practices. Founded by Maya Chen and Dan Okafor. Batch W25. Team size 6. industries: B2B, Accounting; tags: AI, Bookkeeping.

evidence.title: Ledgerline - AI bookkeeping for dental practices
evidence.excerpt: Ledgerline replaces manual bookkeeping for dental practices. Our AI agents reconcile transactions, categorize expenses, and close your books weekly. The company claims customers save 20 hours per week.

evidence.title: Team - Ledgerline
evidence.excerpt: Maya Chen, CEO, previously led payments infrastructure engineering at Stripe. Dan Okafor, CTO, previously sold his last startup to Intuit. The team includes former QuickBooks engineers.

evidence.title: Customers - Ledgerline
evidence.excerpt: The company claims 40 dental groups run their books on Ledgerline, including Smile Dental Partners and Bright Orthodontics.

evidence.title: Show HN: Ledgerline - AI bookkeeping for dental offices
evidence.excerpt: Show HN post - 87 points, 41 comments; posted 2026-08-12.

evidence.title: Ledgerline raises $4M seed round
evidence.excerpt: Ledgerline raised a $4 million seed round led by Actually Ventures to automate dental bookkeeping, TechCrunch has learned.

evidence.title: SmileBook vs Ledgerline comparison
evidence.excerpt: Alternatives and competitors in dental back-office software include SmileBook, Dentisoft, and Ledgerline; incumbents dominate integration with practice management systems.
